title: SoftBank Expands $40 Billion OpenAI Equity Loan with Addition of 21 Lenders Sharing $7 Billion Quota
excerpt: According to informed sources, the $4 billion bridge loan arranged by SoftBank for its equity investment in OpenAI has entered a large-scale distribution phase,
content_html:
According to informed sources, the $4 billion bridge loan arranged by SoftBank for its equity investment in OpenAI has entered a large-scale distribution phase, with 21 new financial institutions participating in the lending, collectively securing about $7 billion in quotas. The Abu Dhabi First Bank, Singapore Government Investment Corporation, and Standard Chartered each took on nearly $1 billion, while the remaining portion was held by multiple European, Japanese, and Taiwan-based banks. The remaining $33 billion of this loan is still held by the lead underwriters and core senior lenders, and may be further distributed outward in the future.

This 12-month loan was signed this March and is one of the largest bridge financing projects in Asia-Pacific history. Underwriters can earn over $100 million in fees from this deal; before the open distribution in May, nine banks had already joined in. Some banks are concerned about the risk exposure of SoftBank's investment in OpenAI, but all relevant parties have declined to comment publicly.

content_html_zh:
据知情人士透露，软银为其股权投资OpenAI安排的40亿美元过桥贷款已进入大规模发放阶段，新增21家金融机构参与放贷，合计获得约70亿美元额度。 阿布扎比第一银行、新加坡政府投资公司和渣打银行各持有近 10 亿美元，其余部分则由多家欧洲、日本和台湾银行持有。 这笔贷款剩余的330亿美元仍由主承销商和核心高级贷款人持有，未来可能会进一步向外分配。

这笔为期 12 个月的贷款于今年 3 月签署，是亚太地区历史上最大的过桥融资项目之一。 承销商可以从这笔交易中赚取超过1亿美元的费用；在5月份公开发行之前，已有9家银行加入。 一些银行担心软银投资OpenAI的风险敞口，但相关各方均拒绝公开置评。
